Name: HeartForge's Seasonal Sam - Vanilla Hair Color
Author: HeartForge
Description:
Tired of Broom-Head Sam? Want more long-haired men in your game? Want Sams Vanilla Hair Color? Voila.

Future plans include:
Sprites
Minor edits and fixes
Custom spirits eve outfit(s?)

Possible plans:
Piercings, Gingerbelley set and custom options.


[u]*This mod does nothing on its own.[/u]
I made this for personal use, intended to be used with [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url], But it will definitely work with [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20608]Seasonal Sam with a Mullet[/url], Or its unseasonal counterpart, [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19330]Sam Mullet Replacement[/url]﻿ until I get his sprites made, if it bothers you. Keep in mind there may be some subtle differences between portrait and sprite.

Thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Gingerbelley?gameId=1303]Gingerbelley[/url] for permission to use their style of Sam's beautiful hair! Go check out their portraits for [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31442?tab=description]Sam's HD style.

[/url]Or check [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33491]here[/url] for a more of a natural blonde﻿ hair Sam.
This mod will not be updated as often or as far as the one there, unless deemed necessary.
